name: commonplace
description: LLM-maintained knowledge base for Obsidian vaults. Auto-triggers on paper sharing, vault health queries, concept compilation, research questions, and domain management.

ambientConnections.title: Ambient vault connections
ambientConnections.description: Surface a one-line pointer beneath an answer when it genuinely connects to a note you have already written. Costs one small model call per rate-limited turn, after the answer is on screen.

primeContext.title: Prime tasks with a vault note
primeContext.description: Before a task starts, show the model one pointer to the note your vault most clearly holds about it (judged by a small model; most prompts get nothing). Off until its precision gate passes on your vault: run commonplace eval:prime.

showBand.title: Vault status band
showBand.description: Show a one-line receipt above the prompt when the vault was consulted, a private domain is open, or surfacing has stopped.
